question: Does Śiva-nature remain established even when reality assumes manifest forms?
premises: The water-wave analogy shows essence persists through changing forms.
Manifest existence corresponds to the arising of forms.
Śiva-nature is the underlying essence of all manifestation.
inference: Even in the state of manifest form, Śiva-nature remains established.
plain_english: Thus, even in the state of manifest existence, Śiva-ness remains firmly established.
